exit=0
--stdout--
_hydra_cli_complete() {
    local cur prev
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 1 ]; then
        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "version help status robots claims claim release limits jog-arm jog table robot audit doctor config shell completion login logout scan fleet stop stop-all metrics manifest connections liveness ecosystem-health plan-simulate" -- "$cur"))
        return 0
    fi
    if [ "${COMP_WORDS[1]}" = "config" ] && [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then
        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "validate apply" -- "$cur"))
        return 0
    fi
    if [ "${COMP_WORDS[1]}" = "fleet" ] && [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then
        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "doctor" -- "$cur"))
        return 0
    fi
    if [ "${COMP_WORDS[1]}" = "manifest" ] && [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 2 ]; then
        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "validate" -- "$cur"))
        return 0
    fi
    case "$cur" in
        -*) COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "--server --config --timeout --json --help" -- "$cur")) ;;
    esac
}
complete -F _hydra_cli_complete hydra-cli
--stderr--
